race.comment: THANKFUL SMILE (15) looked to be showing nice ability in her three runs so far. She does get back into the field but finds the line each and every time. Gets the winkers on now. Should get a lovely run in transit and with three trials to be ready, be hard to hold out. DEXTROSE (6) was so much better the second time of asking. Did get back but made up many lengths. Had the experience here too. SAINT WILLO (16) is bred to be wanting this and further. Can certainly do more now. ESTIVAL (8) will run again after just a fair effort. Does go better second up and is worth including. DIVINE VIXEN (7) is on debut and has had plenty of trials leading in. Expect she is primed for this and worth watching for any market confidence.
